newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony says to sell 32-bit PlayStation for 2-3 years.
newsitem.headline: Sony says to sell 32-bit PlayStation for 2-3 years.

text.p: Sony Corp President Nobuyuki Idei told Reuters on Thursday that Sony planned to continue selling its 32-bit PlayStation game model for at least another two or three years.
Idei said sales of the current 32-bit model were booming.
"We plan to continue selling the 32-bit model for at least another two to three years," he said in an interview. "Changing models frequently is inconvenient for consumers."
